# OpenArena weapon and ammunition models

The downloads target retrieves unmodified MD3 models, TGA diffuse skins and
shader references into `resources/.downloads/openarena_models`. They come from
OpenArena SVN revision 951, licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later (see COPYING).
The downloaded CREDITS retains the project's author list; ammunition models
are by jzero. Both credits files are included in the generated asset package.
The source project is https://openarena.ws/svn/source/assets/.
Exact download URLs and SHA-256 digests are recorded in sources.json.

Arena3D converts the first MD3 frame, normals, UVs and weapon attachment tags to
GLB/PNG at build time. The example's nailgun uses OpenArena's machinegun model.
Its barrel is kept separate and animated about tag_barrel. Muzzle positions
come from tag_flash. Six ammunition types retain their distinct original skins.
The grenade projectile and yellow armor are also original OpenArena models.

Diffuse stages are flattened into texture atlases; the rail energy skin is
retained, while environment-map passes, rail glass and shotgun laser overlays
are omitted. Recoil, idle/walk motion, muzzle flashes, pickup bob/rotation and
grenade tumble are Arena3D presentation animations, not imported skeletal clips.
The health item and muzzle billboard geometry are generated by Arena3D; the
muzzle billboard uses OpenArena's f_machinegun2.tga flash texture.
